editorial.blurb: Adalina Prime is a beautifully designed steakhouse where exceptional service, premium cuts cooked to perfection, and creative touches like their signature salt library create an unforgettable dining experience.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server (like the highly praised Jimmy) for recommendations on which salts from their library pair best with your steak choice—the Truffle, Porcini & Balsamic, and Mushroom salts are standouts that completely transform each bite.
